notes.title: Demo 2.0更新 19-9-2025
notes.content:
<Herbs Seek Slash> Demo 2.0 Updates:

System


-Added an accessory system that can changes appearances and permanently increases abilities once obtained.

-Added a material exchange system that convert excess materials to another.

-After defeating a boss, now you can restart the boss at a certain percentage of its original health (but without bonus rewards).

-After Game Over, now you can return directly to the crafting location.


Keys/UI

-Added Added keybinding customization.

-Most UI elements can now be selected via keyboard.  

-Added a checklist guide to the crafting menu.


Art

-Added new graphics to the opening narrative.

-Updated graphics for dialogue character, witch suggestion, UI, stage background, and some skill effect visuals.


Other:

-Some village objects are now interactive.

notes.title: Demo Update 13/6/2025
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this update will include the following:[/p][p]1. When HP is full, you will automatically pick up the fruit when you touch it; when you are not holding an item and approach a fruit, a pick-up tip will show up.  [/p][p]2. Adjust the shooting position of Ethan.  [/p][p]3. Adjust the hitbox activate time of the enemy's jump attack  [/p][p]4. Adjust the shooting position of Goblin Chieftain.  [/p][p]5. Adjust some death advices of Vedia.  [/p][p]6. Adjust the note in Vedia's house to be easier to understand  [/p][p]7. Rockfall Sword--Remove: speed-1   [/p][p]8. Rockfall Slash--Power of the sword wave reduced, but rock summons even if the wave hits an obstacle /enemy  [/p][p]9. Jumping Rod--Power of the shock wave increased  [/p][p]Thank you for your support[/p]

notes.title: "Herb Seek Slash" Demo Version
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]《Herb Seek Slash》Demo version is now available! There are three main stages in the Demo version, it covers about 30% content of the full version.[/p][p][/p][p]Please feel free to try and give some suggestions, I will take reference and improve my game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have played the Demo version before this announcement, there are some updates in the latest version:[/p][olist][*][p]The beginning narrative is changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Change in the beginning flow: [/p][p]In the previous version, Ethan had to talk to Vedia before he could go out >>[/p][p]This part is skipped in the latest version, will enter the Forest Stage just after the beginning narrative. (That's why the narrative is changed.)[/p][/*][*][p]Key remainder added to the weapon and held item UI in battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage text will pop up with larger size and then shrink.[/p][/*][*][p]"Gain Ability Points" notice displayed when first clearing a stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Change in fonts in most of the UIs, tutorials[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you for your support and patience.[/p]
